text:
jon_support: FYI urgent hand-off. Customer 'NexaHealth' hit onboarding stall — SSO succeeds but embeddings pipeline dropping ~30% of docs. Customer is flagged renewal-risk in 30 days. Need CS triage and comms.
terry_csm: ack. can you summarise impact + steps taken so far?
jon_support: Impact: search relevance degraded, trial users reporting bad results. Steps: re-ingest attempted twice, ingestor job shows intermittent 502s to embedder, no errors in app logs. Attached logs in ticket: https://support.redwood/example/INC-9876
maria_eng: looking. the embedder service has a rate-limiter bump overnight; might be throttling transiently. i'll check quotas and recent deploys.
sam_se: tagging in for on-call infra context — @alex_sre any infra signs (network/egress) last 3 days?
alex_sre: oncall-bot flagged increased 429s from embed-service between 03:10-03:40 UTC yesterday, correlated with a spike in requests from NexaHealth's account id. We throttled per-policy; quota refreshes at midnight. no host CPU/mem anomalies.
terry_csm: critical: customer quoted trial-to-paid decision in 30 days. We need a short comms plan to keep them engaged + a mitigation plan.
jon_support: proposed mitigation: 1) temporarily bump NexaHealth embedding quota on Dedicated pool for next 48h, 2) schedule immediate re-ingest backfill, 3) run quality check on top-50 queries and send results to customer. Need CS consent + PMR for quota change.
maria_eng: can do a targeted quota bump if CS approves. I'll prepare a canary re-ingest script and run locally first. ETA 2 hours for script, 4 hours to backfill depending on docs.
sam_se: from infra side i can approve a short-lived capacity increase. Need a signed sign-off in channel from CSM and support lead.
terry_csm: sign-off: approve quota bump + backfill. I'll be primary comms owner and will send a proactive note to NexaHealth. Message template below — please review.
terry_csm: ```
Hi Sam,
Thanks for flagging. We're seeing an embedding ingestion issue impacting search quality. We're running a targeted backfill now and temporarily increasing ingestion capacity for the next 48 hours to avoid throttles. We'll follow up with a summary of results and a timeline for permanent fix. Expect an update within 6 hours.
—Terry (CSM)
```
jon_support: LGTM — add estimated completion time when you have it.
maria_eng: started canary re-ingest run (job id: reingest-172345). first 1k docs passed. continuing.
alex_sre: infrastructure changes applied: quota bump to account NexaHealth applied to pool-prod-3 for 48h. monitoring alerting thresholds tightened.
terry_csm: I'll send the customer message now and book a 30-min sync tomorrow for demo of results. action items owner list: CSM (terry) -> customer comms; Support (jon) -> ticket updates & doc links; Eng (maria) -> backfill + root cause; SRE (alex) -> monitor and rollback plan.
sam_se: please add the postmortem / RCA checklist to the ticket once root cause identified. Also capture feedback from customer on enablement materials they struggled with.
terry_csm: noted — will capture enablement feedback in ticket and schedule follow-up enablement session with their onboarding lead. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident note created INC-9876-ESCALATION, priority: high, assigned: maria_eng, alex_sre. Alerts will be kept in channel.
jon_support: thanks team. will update ticket and escalate renewal SIG if quality doesn't improve by EOD tomorrow. Keep me posted here.
terry_csm: closing loop for now. ping if any blocker. :eyes:
